name: Low-vol macro-on trend (calm tape gated by risk-on macro regime)
rationale: THESIS: a calm vol regime is necessary but not sufficient — a quiet tape during a risk-OFF macro backdrop is the calm before a bleed, whereas a quiet tape during risk-ON macro is a durable melt-up. We stack two orthogonal regime gates: low realized vol (vol_realized BOUNDED, lt-ceiling, micro-regime) AND macro_regime above a fitted risk-on floor (BOUNDED, macro-regime), then ride long-only trend. The vol-of-regime idea conditioned on the macro tide. DISCONFIRMER: ablate each gate independently — (a) drop vol_realized (macro-trend only), (b) drop macro_regime (vol-trend only). The full conjunction must beat BOTH single-gate variants on deflated-Sharpe net of fees; if either single gate matches it, the other gate is redundant and the two-gate conjunction is fitted over-specification.
catalyst: Realized vol is low AND macro regime is risk-on while price trends up — a calm tape with the macro tide coming in.
